1. Overview
PrimeInspect (AuditInspection Mobile) is a cross-platform mobile application built to digitize field
inspections, quality audits, and task management for organizations that conduct structured checks across
multiple sites, suppliers, or locations. Built with .NET MAUI, it runs natively on both Android and iOS from a
single application.
The application gives field auditors and inspection teams a single mobile workspace to receive assigned
inspection jobs, complete configurable digital checklists, capture supporting evidence such as photos, videos
and signatures, raise follow-up tasks for issues found, and keep all of this data reliably synchronized with a
central backend — even when working in locations with limited or no network connectivity.
2. Business Context
Organizations that run recurring inspections or quality audits across many sites, suppliers, or business
locations typically need to:
●​ Assign inspection jobs and tasks to field auditors and track them through to completion
●​ Capture consistent, standardized checklist responses against a defined quality standard, with photo, video,
note, or signature evidence where required
●​ Keep working reliably even when the field location has poor or no internet connectivity (factories,
warehouses, remote sites)
●​ Raise and track follow-up tasks or service requests for issues and defects identified during an inspection
●​ Control who can view, edit, or approve inspection and audit data based on their role in the organization
●​ Stay informed of job assignments, status changes, and outcomes in near real time
Running this process on paper or disconnected spreadsheets is slow to aggregate, inconsistent between
auditors, and difficult to audit after the fact. PrimeInspect centralizes the entire process — from job
assignment through checklist completion, evidence capture, defect follow-up, and reporting — into a single,
purpose-built mobile application.

4. Functional Modules
4.1 Login & Navigation
Users sign in through a secure login screen. On first login, the app runs a guided data sync that brings down
the user's assigned jobs, forms, and reference data before they begin working. Once signed in, users move
between five core areas — Home, Inspection, Tasks, History, and Menu — each reachable from a single
navigation bar.
4.2 Inspection Job & Task Assignment
●​ View inspection jobs assigned to the logged-in user, with status and due-date tracking
●​ View and manage tasks and service requests, including priority, status, and assignee
●​ A home dashboard summarizes what is assigned, in progress, and due
4.3 Dynamic Inspection Forms & Quality Checklists
●​ Inspection forms are built from templates defined centrally, organized as sections containing checklist items
and fields
●​ Each checklist item can independently require a photo, video, note, or signature before it can be marked
complete
●​ Checklist items can be evaluated against defined quality criteria, supporting standardized quality-control style
audits (for example, acceptable-quality-limit style pass/fail evaluation)
●​ Forms adapt to the client, site, or inspection type being audited
4.4 Evidence Capture & Cloud Storage
●​ In-app camera and file capture for photos, video, and documents, attached directly to the relevant checklist
item
●​ On-screen signature capture pad for sign-off at the point of inspection
●​ Captured media is uploaded to secure cloud storage in the background, independent of the main data sync, so
large files do not block the inspection workflow
4.5 Defect & Service Request Management
●​ Issues or defects identified during an inspection can be raised directly as a task or service request
●​ Each item tracks priority, status, due date, and the assigned owner through to resolution
●​ Supporting documents can be attached to a task or service request as part of the follow-up record
4.6 Offline-First Data Synchronization
●​ All inspection jobs, forms, and submitted data are stored locally on the device, so field work is never blocked
by a lost connection
●​ Every record carries a synchronization flag; anything created or changed offline is queued for upload
●​ The app automatically syncs local changes to the server and pulls the latest server data whenever connectivity
is restored — no manual “refresh” step required
4.7 Notifications & History
●​ A notification center keeps users informed of job assignments and status changes, with read / unread and
mark-all-read support
●​ A history view provides access to previously completed inspections and their full submitted details for later
review
4.8 Role-Based Access Control
Access to each area of the application — inspections, tasks, sites, reports, user administration — is controlled
by a configurable, role-based permission model. Administrators define roles and the capabilities each role
has (view, create, edit, delete) per feature area, and the app enforces this consistently across every screen.

The diagram below traces a typical inspection from login through to a completed, synchronized record.

v

(sections -> checklist items -> fields)
v
Complete Checklist
(photo / video / notes / signature captured per item as required)
v v
Defect / issue found No issues found
v |
Raise Task / Service Request |
v
Media Evidence Uploaded to Cloud Storage (background)
v
Submit Inspection (saved locally, queued for sync)
v
[ Automatic Sync to Server when connectivity is available ]
v

This same offline-first pattern applies to tasks and service requests raised outside of a scheduled inspection — they are
captured locally the moment they are created and synchronized on the same automatic cycle.
6. Reporting & History
Once an inspection is submitted and synchronized, users can:
●​ Review completed inspections and their full checklist responses and evidence in the History view
●​ Open detailed audit records showing every response, attachment, and signature captured during the
inspection
●​ Access previously generated inspection reports in PDF format
●​ Track the status of open tasks and service requests raised from past inspections through to closure

●​ Application architecture — an MVVM, dependency-injected structure with a clean separation between UI,
business logic, and data access
●​ The offline-first data layer, allowing field users to complete full inspections without a live connection and sync
automatically once reconnected
●​ The dynamic form engine that renders inspection checklists from server-defined templates, so forms can be
configured per client without an app update
●​ Native platform integration on Android and iOS, including camera/media capture, signature drawing, and
background cloud upload handling
●​ Role-based access control and the permission model that governs feature-level access across the app
●​ Integration with the backend platform for authentication, job assignment, and data synchronization
9. Business Value & Benefits
●​ Replaces paper-based or disconnected spreadsheet inspections with a single, standardized digital workflow
●​ Keeps field teams productive in locations with unreliable connectivity, with no loss of data and no manual
re-entry once back online
●​ Standardizes how checklist evidence is captured, so every inspection carries the same level of supporting
detail (photos, video, notes, signatures)
●​ Shortens the path from an identified defect to a tracked, assigned follow-up task
●​ Improves accountability and audit-readiness through a complete, reviewable history of every inspection
●​ Gives administrators fine-grained control over who can see or change inspection and audit data
●​ Reduces the operational overhead of managing inspection data manually across multiple sites or suppliers
10. Outcome & Impact
PrimeInspect gives organizations a single, consolidated mobile system that carries an inspection from initial
job assignment through checklist completion, evidence capture, defect follow-up, and final review —
available natively on both Android and iOS from one application.
By building the application offline-first, field teams are no longer dependent on constant connectivity to do
their work, while the organization still gets a fully synchronized, centralized, and auditable record of every
inspection once devices reconnect. The result is a more consistent, traceable, and efficient inspection
process across every site, supplier, or location the organization manages.
